question: The average of the set of scores 512, 528, 556, 584 and 615 is:
solution:
**Calculation:**

The average of the set of scores 512, 528, 556, 584 and 615 is

(512 + 528 + 556 + 584 + 615) / 5 

⇒ 2795 /5 = 529
